info.title: SOMI Person 3 API
info.description: Session/workspace/RBAC protected APIs. Unsafe requests require same-origin Origin or Fetch Metadata. Decimal money and IDs are JSON strings. Payout uses manual bank transfer and audited reconciliation, never an automatic transfer. See PERSON3-API.md for state rules and integration contracts.
